LanguageData.HD_Shotgun_SpreadFactor_Desc:
Configured spread factor: {0}

Pellets from the same shell share the first hit part for each target. The spread factor is the maximum number of parent links to ascend from that part. At each parent, only its immediate children, one link down, become hit candidates. Grandchildren are excluded through that parent.

A factor of 1 ascends one parent link and descends at most one child link. For example, if a lung's parent is the chest, only the chest's immediate children can be hit. A factor of 0 concentrates subsequent pellets on the first hit part. If the first hit part has no parent, factors of 1 or more include that part and its immediate children.

Missing parts and parts below a missing ancestor are excluded. This setting applies to buckshot; single-projectile ammunition is unaffected.
